Made up for testing: a Darwin Core Archive with an Occurrence core, unzipped.

- `occurrence.txt`: two pinned specimens from one field trip (same `fieldNumber`) and one
  photographed observation. No `occurrenceStatus`, as in many archives.
- `multimedia.txt`: the observation's photo (GBIF Simple Multimedia).
- `measurementorfact.txt`: body length of the two specimens.
- `meta.xml`, `eml.xml`.
